## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Scope
- [ ] This change is within an approved project or documentation scope.
- [ ] No unrelated project scope has been added.

## Implementation and evidence
Describe the implementation and relevant design decisions.

### Tests
List exact commands and results. Mark tests not run.

### Security
Describe identity, permissions, trust boundaries, secrets and side effects.

### AWS and cost
List AWS services/resources affected, region, estimate, test window and teardown plan. For documentation-only changes, state that no AWS resources are created.

### Operational impact
Describe reliability, observability, rollback and compatibility implications.

### Limitations
List known limitations and remaining work.

## Checklist
- [ ] Documentation updated.
- [ ] Tests added or updated.
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data committed.
- [ ] Dependencies/licenses reviewed where applicable.
- [ ] Claims match demonstrated evidence.
